packageRules.description: Keep Spring Boot, the Spring Cloud train, and Spring Cloud Config in a single PR - Boot's version is dictated by whichever Cloud train is in use, and project.version is derived from spring-cloud-config, so all three must move together for auto-release to fire correctly.
Never auto-merge - bumps need a real CI run (multi-arch image build + testcontainers integration matrix) and occasional code changes before merging.
